violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. The chlorine dish machine in the BOH for cups was not working properly at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL DISHWASHERS NEED TO BE WORKING PROPERLY AT ALL TIMES. PIC CALLED ECO LAB AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION AND WAS ABLE TO SCHEDULE MAINTENANCE ON THE DISH WASHER. FACILITY HAS MULTIPLE DISH WASHING MACHINES AND SET UP THE 3 VAT SINK IN ORDER TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE THE CUPS THAT WOULD BE WASHED IN THE DISH MACHINE THAT IS NOT WORKING PROPERLY AND WILL SEND EHS A PIC OF THE INVOICE AFTER THE WORK IS COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The chemical sanitizing dish machine at the bar is not operating properly and is producing less than 50 ppm chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain a chlorine concentration between 50-200ppm. Do not use the unit to sanitize dishes while it is not operating properly. Please send a repair invoice within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Facility ordered a dish plate thermometer that will arrive soon.
